image_description: A still life composition featuring four rolls of toilet paper arranged on a wooden surface against a plain beige wall. The rolls vary in state: one is upright and intact, one is lying on its side, one is partially unrolled with sheets spreading out, and one is stacked or deformed. There is also a jar visible in the background on the left.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Soft, thin, absorbent paper wound into cylindrical roll around cardboard tube.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While there are cylindrical shapes, the 'winding' structure is largely missing or melted. The central roll appears as a solid, amorphous blob rather than distinct layers of wound paper. The cardboard tube is not clearly visible in any roll.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Roll is compact with modest diameter and width, suitable for standard bathroom holder.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The general scale and proportions of the objects resemble toilet paper rolls, despite the structural deformities.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Individual sheets perforated for easy tearing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No perforation lines are visible. The unrolled sections appear as continuous, smooth sheets without the characteristic dotted tear lines.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly textured, embossed surface pattern (quilted or dotted).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fibrous, quilted, or embossed detail typical of toilet paper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cardboard core visible at center of roll.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: None of the rolls clearly show the brown cardboard tube at the center. The centers are either occluded, filled with white material, or structurally collapsed.
The objects are white/off-white, consistent with the class label.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte, fibrous texture with visible paper fibers at close range.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture appears waxy, shiny, or like smooth plastic/clay rather than matte and fibrous. It lacks the micro-detail of paper fibers.
Same as above; no separation lines are discernible on the unrolled portions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Household paper product in roll format.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The scene context (wooden floor/table, jar) and general shape suggest household paper products, even if the material rendering is incorrect.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The central mass of toilet paper rolls has melted together into an indistinguishable, amorphous white blob. Individual rolls lose their cylindrical integrity and fuse into one another.
The material renders as smooth, semi-translucent plastic or wax rather than opaque, fibrous paper. It lacks the expected surface roughness and light scattering of paper.
The unrolled paper lies flat but lacks thickness and realistic creasing. It blends slightly into the wooden surface, suggesting poor grounding.
The cardboard cores are completely missing. In AI generation, hollow cylinders often fail to render correctly, resulting in solid centers or collapsed geometry.

Presence and visibility of cardboard cores
Surface texture fidelity (fibrous paper vs. smooth plastic/wax)
Boundary definition between individual rolls in the stacked/fused area
Realism of unrolled sheet physics (creases, thickness, contact shadows)
